reconcile.note: Gill answers that believers are sons of God by adoption, a lesser sense than Christ's natural sonship and a higher sense than Adam's by creation, so the titles do not clash.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible catalogues the "only begotten" title for Jesus, Adam's divine sonship, and believers' sonship as three incompatible answers to one question.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible, "How many sons does God have?"

sides.snippet: he has not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God
sides.verseText: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn't believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.

sides.snippet: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
sides.verseText: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.
